Contract validation and generated-client freshness passed. PostgreSQL 17 applied both migrations and passed the transactional reset, append-only ordering, idempotency, provider allowlist, scheduler lease recovery, outcome-unknown reconciliation, no-blind-retry, and inert-reset rehearsal. ML training reproduced all four committed artifacts byte-for-byte; Python and TypeScript golden-vector parity and fail-closed runtime behavior passed. A sentinel production build embedded only VITE_API_BASE_URL and excluded operator/scenario/database/cron/Twilio/ElevenLabs names and values, with no source maps. Root and frontend npm audits found zero vulnerabilities. The first combined database/ML invocation with the system Python failed during ML collection because numpy was not installed globally; no test was skipped or retried as flaky, and the same required suite passed in the repository's pinned .venv (including the configured python3 command with .venv/bin first on PATH). No live provider call, Railway mutation, real patient data, or external effect occurred.
